name: Marla's Last Wish
summary: In Deathknell, Marla's Last Wish brings a husband and wife together in death. Novice Elreth asks you to find Samuel Fipps, still bound to the Scourge, so he may be buried beside Marla. The Forsaken honor the ties of life and set themselves apart from the Scourge.

sections.title: A Tragic Reunion
sections.body: Before the Third War, Marla and Samuel Fipps were husband and wife in Lordaeron. The war devastated their home, and when the plague swept through their lands, Samuel succumbed. He rose as a mindless thrall of the Scourge. Marla escaped undeath, but Samuel killed her in his frenzy. She bore him no hatred. Novice Elreth remembers Marla's final wish: to rest beside Samuel in the Deathknell graveyard.

sections.title: Respecting the Dead
sections.body: Novice Elreth sends you northeast of Deathknell, where Samuel Fipps still wanders among a ruined campsite. Ending his torment removes a Scourge minion from the valley. Then his remains can be carried back to Marla's resting place. Elreth believes that honoring the dead and their final wishes sets the newly freed Forsaken apart from the Scourge.

faq.answer: Marla Fipps lived in Lordaeron and survived the plague, but Samuel killed her after he became a mindless Scourge thrall. She wished to rest beside him.

Samuel Fipps was Marla's husband before the plague. He fell to the Scourge and lost his mind, then killed Marla. Until Forsaken adventurers end his torment, he wanders a ruined campsite northeast of Deathknell.

faq.q: Why does Novice Elreth care about burying them together?
faq.answer: Novice Elreth was Marla's friend in life. Elreth believes that honoring the dead and treating their remains with dignity shows the Forsaken have kept their humanity and morality, unlike the mindless Scourge.
No. Novice Elreth says Marla was spared undeath. Samuel killed her while she was still mortal, and she was buried in the Deathknell graveyard.
Marla's grave lies in the first row of the cemetery just outside Deathknell's main chapel.

faq.q: Where can Samuel Fipps be found?
faq.answer: Samuel Fipps wanders a ruined campsite along the road northeast of Deathknell.

angles.text: As a newly risen Forsaken, fulfilling Marla's wish can bind you to your former human life. It shows that compassion and honor survived Lordaeron's fall.
As a Forsaken priest, Novice Elreth's insistence on proper burial rites speaks to your spiritual duty amid mortality, grief, and the desecration of Lordaeron's dead.
